FLASHCARD · MATCHING & SORTING · AGES 2 YEARS

Match Blue Flashcard for Toddlers

The same game in blue: one blue thing to match, a little row to look through. Blue is calm to look at and easy to find in most rooms, which keeps the game friendly.

Say it together

“Blue and blue! Can you find the two that match?”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the word, the sound, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

Match the card to a real blue object — the blue cup, the blue book — and let your toddler do the final pointing. Then swap: you point wrong on purpose and let them correct you. Toddlers love fixing grown-ups.

Quick parent note

Deliberate mistakes are a sneaky-good teaching move. Get it "wrong", look puzzled, and enjoy being corrected.
